bio.text:
I'm a product engineer in New York. I co-founded ChekOut AI, where I design and build the AI agents that sell inside merchants' own stores, and I built KYURI.OS, the system that runs my own job search.

I got here through AR experiences for fashion and beauty brands at Arlene and a master's in Human-Computer Interaction at Georgia Tech. These days the design and the code come from the same hands, and the job is still making complex ideas accessible, functional and beautiful.

I design for the subway test. Good experiences earn attention in the in-between moments: a commute, a queue, one bar of signal.
